e25: lead ↔ lug is not a compatible pair
notes: Arduino Due is not in the catalogue; a new part type with only the header pins used by the shield (plus DC jack and USB) is defined.
The Motor Shield is stacked on the Due; only the shield pins listed in the catalogue entry are joined to the matching Due headers.

The DC motor's own red/black leads go straight into the channel A screw terminals (red to A+, black to A-); no separate jumper wires are used. Motor lead polarity is arbitrary since the motor is symmetric.
Wall wart supplies about 12V to the Due DC jack, as in the manual's example fan.

The photo shows a second black cable plugged into the Due's micro-USB port; it is modelled as a USB cable to the computer running the Arduino IDE. The usb-cable catalogue entry has no ports, so ports are null.
The code uses pins 3 (PWM_A), 12 (DIR_A), 9 (BRAKE_A) and A0 (SNS_A), which come through the shield stacking headers; no extra wires are needed.
